scope: Declared backend/operation inventory with current synthetic test execution; not a per-campaign availability list or all-branch certification.

tests.scope: Current synthetic test executions and detached probes; no all-branch certification
limits: Repeated probes are observations, not unique committed world events.
Failed-attempt writes are scratch attempts, never committed effects.
Paths are unioned per operation/backend/profile/test/status, not branch-complete.
Rejected probes mirror the current R9 backend selection policy.

limitations: Observed paths are unions of executed cases, not declared event footprints.
Failed-attempt writes are rolled back and never counted as committed effects.
Tests that fail, error, skip or lack attribution cannot qualify an operation.
A successful direct call must match the observer-selected backend post-state.
Owner annotations interpret known namespaces; unmapped or mixed paths stay explicit.
Validation scans are separate from allocation dependencies.
Legacy aliases are compatibility spellings, not separate maintained engines.
No saved campaigns or inherited coverage logs are inputs. Historical fixture content is hashed as test input; it does not schedule a historical future.
Actual apply calls and detached observer probes are distinguished. Neither observation count proves a durable host commit.
Review-handler instrumentation does not certify arbitrary Python plugins.
